notes: V0.9.0: FCM push — the reliable fix for closed-app notifications. Client: Push.register() no longer gated on pushOn (it now attempts registration whenever the plugin is present and only succeeds once Firebase is connected), creates a Messages notification channel, and POSTs the device token to the server (/push-token). Server (worker-v090.js): new push_tokens table, POST/DELETE /push-token, and on every /send it sends a high-priority FCM notification (sender name only, never message content) via the FCM HTTP v1 API using the FCM_KEY service-account secret; stale tokens are pruned. Also: notifyNew() now uses isExactNotification:false + allowWhileIdle:true (no exact-alarm hang, fires in Doze), and the plugin manifest adds SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM. FCM is inert until Kodi provides google-services.json (app) + the FCM_KEY service-account secret and runs cloudflare.sh (server).
